page.overview:
Who is Meneldor?

Meneldor was a Great Eagle who dwelt at one of the eyries in the northern half of the Misty Mountains.

He was a friend and follower of Gwaihir and probably dwelt with him at one of the eyries of the Misty Mountains. He along with Gwaihir and Landroval was one of the Eagles who rescued Frodo and Sam from the slopes of Mount Doom, after the destruction of the One Ring.

The first element of Meneldor, menel, means "heaven".

In , Meneldor and his brother Landroval appear at several points throughout the game. The player first meet them in the Wailing Hills south of Lothlórien where they help the Eagles deal with an infestastion of spiders. After their participation in the Battle of the Morannon, the player meets the Eagles once again when they reach the Carrock.
